blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Reasoning models become long-horizon agents through reinforcement learning or, more cheaply, through fine-tuning on a stronger teacher's trajectories, which contain the teacher's chain-of-thought as well as its actions. The standard fine-tuning approach imitates both, yet the strongest teachers are closed models whose chain-of-thought is hidden behind an API. We show that the chain-of-thought can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher's actions alone. The student is trained on these trajectories with its reasoning block left empty, while a KL loss on a replay buffer of its own generations limits drift from its initial model. Surprisingly, the policy learned from these trajectories with an empty reasoning block carries over to inference with thinking enabled, where the student reasons in its own style while acting like the teacher, an effect we call cross-format transfer. Distilling the actions of Qwen3.6-27B raises the task success of Qwen3-4B on AppWorld from 7% to 18% and that of Qwen3-32B from 12% to 25%. We further introduce CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher's reasoning placed after the empty reasoning block, which raise Qwen3-4B further, to 35%. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies need the hidden chain-of-thought, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers. Distilling GPT-5.6 Luna from its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns raises Qwen3-4B from 7% to 48% on AppWorld and from 3% to 28% on SWE-bench Verified.
blocks.zh: 理性模型通过强化学习或更便宜地通过微调更强的教师轨迹而成为了长相视野的代言人,这些代言包含教师的思想链及其行动. 标准微调方法模仿两者,然而最强的教师是封闭模型,其思维链被隐藏在API后. 我们显示,思维链可以完全忽略,长远政策可以从老师的行动中提炼出来. 学生接受过这些轨迹的培训,其推理块被留空了,而KL在自己世代的回放缓冲器上的损失限制了从最初的模型上漂移. 令人惊讶的是,从这些带有空洞推理屏障的轨迹学来的政策, 继续推导出思维的功能, 学生们在自己风格上的理由, 同时又像老师一样, 我们称之为跨格式转移。 将Qwen3.6-27B的动作分解,将Qwen3-4B在AppWorld上的任务成功率从7%提高到18%,而Quen3-32B的任务成功率从12%提高到25%. 我们进一步介绍CoT代理, 简略总结老师在空推理块之后的推理, 由于无论是行动还是CoT代理都不需要隐藏的思想链,因此秘方适用于封闭的教师。 在AppWorld上将 Qwen3-4B 的 7% 提升到 48% , 在 SWE-bench 上从 3% 提升到 28% 。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Language models are increasingly deployed as agents that act in an environment over many steps to reach a goal, with the model running inside a harness that gives it tools, executes its actions and manages the history it sees ( Yao et al., 2023 ; Yang et al., 2024 ) . A coding agent, for example, explores a repository and runs shell commands, while a personal assistant calls the APIs of everyday applications on behalf of a user ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) . In both cases the quality of the agent rests on its policy , that is, on the action it chooses given the task and everything that has happened so far.
blocks.zh: 语言模型越来越多地被部署为在环境中为实现目标而跨出许多步骤的代理人,模型运行在给它提供工具、实施其行动和管理其所见历史的吊带内(姚等人,2023年;杨等人,2024年)。 例如,一个编码代理来探索一个寄存器并运行 shell 命令,而个人助理代表一个用户调用日常应用程序的API(Trivedi et al., 2024). 在这两种情况下,代理人的质量取决于其政策,即它选择的任务和迄今所发生的一切行动。

blocks.en: Obtaining such a policy is a post-training problem, and the usual way to solve it is reinforcement learning in the environment ( Kimi Team et al., 2026 ; Luo et al., 2025 ) . An alternative, especially for smaller models, is to distill the policy from a stronger teacher model that is already capable on long-horizon agentic tasks, by supervised fine-tuning on its trajectories ( Pan et al., 2025 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) . The standard recipe supervises the full trajectory, which typically consists of a chain-of-thought (CoT), some visible commentary and an action such as a shell command or an API call.
blocks.zh: 获得这种政策是一个培训后的问题,通常的解决办法是加强环境学习(Kimi Team等人,2026年;Luo等人,2025年)。 另一种办法,特别是对于较小的模型,是通过对其轨迹进行有监督的微调,从更强大的教师模型中提炼出政策,这种模型已经能够执行长视距代理任务(Pan等人,2025年;Yang等人,2026年)。 标准食谱监督整个轨迹,一般包括一个思维链(CoT),一些可见的评论和诸如 shell 命令或API调用等动作.

blocks.en: We study this setting for students that are already post-trained reasoning models, which reason well on single-turn problems but remain weak on long-horizon tasks. Distilling a new policy into such a model has to add a capability without losing the ones it already has, making it a continual-learning problem. Training on the teacher’s CoT then has a practical limit. The strongest teachers are closed models behind an API whose reasoning is hidden, since providers such as OpenAI return encrypted reasoning items and at most a summary, and they encrypt the reasoning precisely to prevent this kind of distillation ( Panfilov et al., 2026 ) . The teacher’s reasoning may also not suit the student, since small models have been found to learn poorly from traces of strong reasoners ( Li et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 我们为那些已经受过后训练的推理模式的学生研究这个环境,这些模式很好地说明单回合问题的原因,但在长期任务上却仍然软弱无力。 将新政策纳入这种模式必须增加一种能力,而不失去它已经具备的能力,使它成为一个不断学习的问题。 师资培训则具有实际限制。 最强的教师是API背后的封闭模型,其推理被隐藏,因为OpenAI等提供者返回加密推理项目,最多是一份摘要,他们加密推理恰恰是为了防止这种蒸馏(Panfilov等人,2026年). 老师的推理可能也不适合学生,因为人们发现小模型从强力理性的痕迹学得不好(Li等人,2025年).

blocks.en: In this paper we show that the CoT can be left out altogether and that the long-horizon policy can be distilled from the teacher’s actions alone. To this end, we render each teacher turn into a training target in which the reasoning block is left empty and is followed directly by the action. To limit drift from the initial model, we regularize the student toward its initial checkpoint with a replay buffer, as is common in the continual-learning literature and in KL-regularized fine-tuning ( Li and Hoiem, 2017 ; Rolnick et al., 2019 ; Ziegler et al., 2020 ) . Concretely, every batch also contains a few of the student’s own generations on prompts from another domain, and a KL term computed on them pulls the student toward its initial checkpoint. The student is then evaluated with its thinking enabled. As a result, no reasoning is ever supervised, yet at inference the student still reasons in its own way while its high-level behaviour follows the teacher’s policy, an effect we call cross-format transfer . Such a transfer across formats has been observed before, in a safety setting. Fine-tuning a reasoning model with its CoT disabled on narrowly misaligned data produces broad misalignment that persists once the CoT is re-enabled at evaluation ( Chua et al., 2025 ) . We ask whether the same mechanism can transfer a useful policy. One reason to expect so is that failures of language models on long tasks have been attributed to execution rather than to reasoning ( Sinha et al., 2026 ) . If execution is what fails, then the actions may be all that needs to be taught, and the student’s own reasoning, which is already good on single turns, can be left as it is.
blocks.zh: 在这份论文中,我们表明,完全可以忽略远程教育,而长期政策可以从教师的行动中提炼出来。 为此,我们让每个老师变成一个训练目标,其中推理块被空置,直接跟着行动. 为了限制最初模式的漂移,我们用重播缓冲器将学生正规化,这在继续学习的文献和KL正规化的微调(Li和Hoiem,2017年;Rolnick等人,2019年;Ziegler等人,2020年)中很常见。 具体地说,每批学生中也有几代学生从另一个领域得到的提示,在他们身上计算出一个KL术语,将学生引向最初的检查站。 然后用其思维能力对该学生进行评估。 因此,没有任何推理被监督,然而,根据推断,学生仍然以自己的方式提出理由,而其高水平的行为却遵循教师的政策,我们称之为跨格式转移。 以前在安全环境下观察到过这种跨格式的转移。 调整其推理模型,使其在狭小的错位数据上失去功能,产生广泛的错位,一旦在评价时重新启用计算机,这种错位就持续存在(Chua等人,2025年)。 我们问同一机制是否能够转移一项有用的政策。 期望如此的一个原因是长期任务的语言模型的失败被归咎于执行而不是推理(Sinha等人,2026年). 如果执行失败了,那么行动可能就是所有需要教的,而学生自己的推理,在单轮上已经是好的,可以照原样离开.

blocks.en: The teacher’s reasoning is nevertheless useful, and we show that the student can still benefit from it without training on the CoT directly. For this purpose we give the student a proxy for the teacher’s reasoning, which we call a CoT-proxy: a short summary of that reasoning, placed after the empty reasoning block, that serves as an additional training target explaining the action that follows. The aim is to pass the student a signal about what the teacher was thinking without making it imitate the CoT itself, and we show that this simple substitution works. Since neither actions nor CoT-proxies require access to the full hidden CoT, the recipe applies unchanged to closed teachers, whose APIs return only reasoning summaries. We show that such distillation is possible in practice.
blocks.zh: 老师的推理是有用的,我们显示,学生仍然可以从中得益,而不直接接受COT的训练。 为此,我们给学生一个教师推理的代名词,我们称之为CoT代名词:在空推理块之后,对这个推理作一个简短的总结,作为解释以下行动的补充训练目标。 目的是向学生传递一个信号,说明老师的想法,而不让它模仿CoT本身,我们表明这个简单的替代方法是可行的。 由于无论是行动还是CoT代理都不要求进入完全隐藏的COT,因此该配方适用于封闭的教师,其API只返回推理摘要. 我们表明,这种蒸馏在实践中是可能的。

blocks.en: Our contributions are as follows. • We propose a recipe that distills a teacher’s long-horizon policy into a post-trained reasoning student from the teacher’s actions alone, with an empty reasoning block in every training target and a KL replay term that holds the student near its initial model. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified the policy transfers to a 4B and a 32B student, which then execute it with their own reasoning at inference. • We propose CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher’s reasoning that give the student a signal about the teacher’s CoT without having it imitate the CoT itself. Added to action-only training, they improve task success in every setting. • We show that action-only and CoT-proxy training apply to closed teachers, whose CoT is hidden behind an API, and demonstrate it on GPT-5.6 Luna, using only its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns. • We test which parts of the recipe matter, finding that the replay data has to come from outside the target environment and that the summary has to sit outside the think block, and investigate how each training target changes the student’s reasoning at inference.
blocks.zh: • 我们的贡献如下。 我们提出一种方法,将老师的长视野政策提炼成一个仅从老师的行动中培养出来的后推理学生,在每个训练目标中都有一个空洞的推理障碍,以及一个KL重播术语,让学生接近其最初的模式. 在AppWorld和SWE-bench上验证了向一名4B和一名32B学生的政策转移,然后根据他们自己的推论加以执行。 我们提出共同教师代言人(comT-processes), 简单总结老师的推理, 给学生一个关于老师的COT的信号, • 增加只用于行动的培训,提高每个环境的任务成功率。 我们显示,只行动培训和CoT-代用培训适用于封闭式教师,他们的CoT隐藏在API后面,并在GPT-5.6 Luna上演示,只使用其可见的输出和推理总结其API返回. ^ 我们测试食谱的哪些部分很重要,发现重播数据必须来自目标环境之外,摘要必须坐到思维障碍之外,并调查每个训练目标如何改变学生的推论。

blocks.en: We propose a recipe that distills a teacher’s long-horizon policy into a post-trained reasoning student from the teacher’s actions alone, with an empty reasoning block in every training target and a KL replay term that holds the student near its initial model. On AppWorld and SWE-bench Verified the policy transfers to a 4B and a 32B student, which then execute it with their own reasoning at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一种方法,将老师的长视野政策提炼成一个仅从老师的行动中培养出来的后推理学生,在每个训练目标中都有一个空洞的推理障碍,以及一个KL重播术语,让学生接近其最初的模式. 在AppWorld和SWE-bench上验证了政策转移给一个4B和一个32B的学生,然后由他们自己推论执行.

blocks.en: We propose CoT-proxies, short summaries of the teacher’s reasoning that give the student a signal about the teacher’s CoT without having it imitate the CoT itself. Added to action-only training, they improve task success in every setting.
blocks.zh: 我们提出共同教师代言人(comT-processes), 简单总结老师的推理, 给学生一个关于老师的COT的信号, 在只开展行动的培训中,它们提高了每个环境的任务成功率。

blocks.en: We show that action-only and CoT-proxy training apply to closed teachers, whose CoT is hidden behind an API, and demonstrate it on GPT-5.6 Luna, using only its visible outputs and the reasoning summaries its API returns.
blocks.zh: 我们显示,只有动作和CoT-代用训练适用于封闭的教师,他们的CoT隐藏在API后面,并在GPT-5.6 Luna上演示,只使用其可见的输出和推理总结了其API返回.

blocks.en: We test which parts of the recipe matter, finding that the replay data has to come from outside the target environment and that the summary has to sit outside the think block, and investigate how each training target changes the student’s reasoning at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们测试食谱的哪些部分很重要,发现重播数据必须来自目标环境之外,摘要必须坐到思维障碍之外,并调查每个训练目标如何改变学生的推论。

blocks.en: Figure 1: The three training targets and the student’s inference format, shown for one turn. Each teacher turn is rendered into a target with a prefilled prefix (grey, no loss) and a supervised remainder (blue). The full-CoT target prefills only the opening of the reasoning block and supervises the teacher’s thought and action; the action-only target prefills an empty block and supervises only the action; the CoT-proxy target additionally supervises a summary of the thought between the empty think block and the action. At inference only the opening token is prefilled, allowing the student to generate its own reasoning before acting (green). The inference row illustrates the intended structure, not a constraint enforced on generated responses. Earlier turns of a trajectory are rendered in the same representation as the target turn.
blocks.zh: 图 1: 三个培训指标和学生的推论格式为一转。 每个教师都变成一个目标,有一个预先填充的前缀(灰色,不丢失)和一个监督的剩余部分(蓝色)。 全CoT目标只预填推理块的打开并监督老师的思想和行动;只动作目标预填空块,只监督动作;CoT代理目标额外监督空构思块与动作之间的思考摘要. 推论中只预填开封符,让学生在演绎(绿色)前产生自己的推理. 推论一行说明了预期的结构,而不是对生成的答复施加的限制。 轨道的较早转弯与目标转弯相同。

blocks.en: 2 Method
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: This section describes how we turn teacher trajectories into training targets, how CoT-proxies provide a signal about the teacher’s reasoning without reproducing it, and how we limit drift from the initial model while it learns a new policy.
blocks.zh: 本节描述了我们如何将教师的轨迹转化为培训目标,CoT代言人如何在不复制教师推理的情况下提供教师推理的信号,以及我们如何在学习新政策的同时限制最初模式的漂移。

blocks.en: An agent trajectory is a sequence of turns. In each turn the model produces hidden reasoning inside a think block, opened by the token <think> and closed by </think> , then optionally some visible prose, and finally an action, which can be a Python cell or a bash command that the harness executes. The harness returns an observation and the next turn begins. We refer to the mapping from the task and the history of previous actions and observations to the next action as the policy . We refer to the model’s performance with thinking enabled on single-turn reasoning benchmarks as its single-turn capability .
blocks.zh: 代理轨迹是转弯的顺序. 在每一转动中,模型都会在思维块内产生隐藏的推理,由符号<思维>打开,然后由</思维>关闭,然后可选地产生一些可见的散文,最后是动作,可以是Python细胞,也可以是吊带执行的bash命令. 绳子返回一个观察,下一个转弯开始。 我们把从任务和以往行动与观察的历史到下一个行动的情况描绘成政策。 我们把模型的性能和单回合推理基准的思维能力称为单回合能力。

blocks.en: Each teacher turn is rendered into one of three training targets, illustrated in Figure 1 . The full-CoT target is the conventional one, in which the think block holds the teacher’s reasoning and everything after the opening token is supervised, the reasoning as well as the closing token and the action. The action-only target instead prefills an empty think block and supervises only the action that follows it. The empty block receives no loss, so it conditions the supervised tokens without teaching the student to produce an empty block itself. The chosen representation is applied to every turn of a trajectory, including the earlier assistant turns that form the context of a later one, so that an action-only example never exposes the teacher’s reasoning through its history. At inference every student, whatever its training target, generates with its thinking enabled. Only the opening token is prefilled, the student fills the think block with its own reasoning, and that reasoning is kept in the history of later turns. We call the transfer of a policy learned from targets without reasoning to this inference setting cross-format transfer .
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,每个教师转变成三个培训目标之一。 全CoT目标为常规目标,其中思想块持有老师的推理,并在开信牌被监督之后的一切,推理以及关闭信牌和动作. 仅行动目标反而预填一个空的思维块,并只监督它之后的动作. 空块不会受到损失,因此它不教学生自己生产空块就给被监管的符牌设条件. 所选择的表达方式适用于轨迹的每一个转折,包括早期的助理转折,形成后来的转折背景,这样一个只行动的例子就永远不会暴露教师的推理历史. 推论每个学生,无论其培训目标如何,都能通过思考产生。 只预置开封令牌,学生用自己的推理填充思想块,推理保存在后期转折的历史中. 我们要求将从目标中汲取的政策从没有推理的推论转移到这种跨格式的推论。

blocks.en: The CoT-proxy target puts part of the teacher’s reasoning back, but outside the think block and in condensed form. It keeps the empty think block of the action-only target and inserts a short summary of the teacher’s reasoning, wrapped in a <summary> block, between the empty block and the action. The summary is meant to capture the decision behind the action rather than the reasoning itself, and it never enters the think block. For the open teacher we obtain the summaries offline by asking the teacher to condense each turn’s own reasoning into at most two sentences, given only that turn’s thought and neither the action nor later observations. For the closed teacher, in our case an OpenAI model, we use the reasoning summaries that its API returns alongside the visible output, without any further processing. Appendix A describes the full summarization pipeline, including the prompts.
blocks.zh: CoT-代理目标将部分老师的推理放回原位,但是在思想块之外并以凝聚的形式. 它保留了只行动对象的空思维块,并插入了老师推理的简短摘要,用一个"摘要"块包裹,在空块和动作之间. 摘要意在捕捉行动背后的决定而不是推理本身,它从未进入思想块. 对于开放的老师来说, 我们要求老师将自己的推理压缩为最多两句, 对于封闭的老师来说,就我们来说,OpenAI模型,我们使用其API与可见输出同时返回的推理摘要,无需任何进一步处理. 附 录 A描述了整个汇总管道,包括提示.

blocks.en: To limit changes to the student’s existing capabilities, we regularize it toward its initial checkpoint on a fixed replay corpus. Before fine-tuning, the initial student generates responses to a pool of prompts from outside the target environment, so that the regularization anchors the student to its general behaviour rather than to the task being distilled, and every training update then mixes a small number of these replay samples with the teacher samples. Teacher samples receive cross-entropy supervision on their target, while replay samples receive a KL penalty that pulls the trained student’s next-token distribution toward that of the initial student on the same saved responses. A related approach recovers capability lost to fine-tuning by on-policy distillation from the initial model ( Lu and Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) ; our penalty instead uses a fixed corpus of the initial model’s generations and needs no sampling during training.
blocks.zh: 为了限制学生现有能力的变化,我们通过固定的重播程序,使学生进入初始检查站。 在微调前,初学者会从目标环境外生成对一组提示的响应,这样规范化将学生固定在一般行为而非被提炼的任务上,每次培训更新之后都会将少量这些重播样本与老师样本混合. 教师的样本在目标上接受交叉的观察,而重播的样本则接受KL的处罚,将受训学生的下一张分布图拉到初生学生的下一张分布图上。 相关方法恢复了最初模型(Lu and Thinking Machines Lab,2025年)中因政策提炼而失去的微调能力;我们的惩罚是使用最初模型的几代人的固定体,在训练期间不需要取样。

blocks.en: Let 𝒯 \mathcal{T} and ℛ \mathcal{R} be the supervised token positions of the teacher and replay samples in one update, with N t = | 𝒯 | N_{t}=|\mathcal{T}| and N r = | ℛ | N_{r}=|\mathcal{R}| , and for a position i i let h i h_{i} be its context and y i y_{i} its target token. We minimize ℒ ( θ ) = − 1 N t ∑ i ∈ 𝒯 log p θ ( y i ∣ h i ) + 1 N r ∑ i ∈ ℛ KL ( p init ( ⋅ ∣ h i ) ∥ p θ ( ⋅ ∣ h i ) ) , \mathcal{L}(\theta)=-\frac{1}{N_{t}}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{T}}\log p_{\theta}(y_{i}\mid h_{i})+\frac{1}{N_{r}}\sum_{i\in\mathcal{R}}\mathrm{KL}\!\left(p_{\mathrm{init}}(\cdot\mid h_{i})\,\|\,p_{\theta}(\cdot\mid h_{i})\right), (1) where the KL is taken over the full vocabulary and each sum is normalized by its own token count. With LoRA fine-tuning ( Hu et al., 2022 ) , which we use in all experiments, p init p_{\mathrm{init}} comes from the same base model with the adapter disabled, which costs an extra forward pass but no second copy of the weights. The penalty needs logits from the initial student only, never from the teacher, and it uses a fixed offline corpus rather than fresh environment interaction, which is what makes it applicable to closed teachers. Replay construction and implementation details are given in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 3 Experimental setup
blocks.zh: 3 实验设置

blocks.en: We study policy distillation in two long-horizon environments. AppWorld ( Trivedi et al., 2024 ) asks an agent to operate everyday applications through their APIs on behalf of a user, and we use its test-normal split of 168 tasks grouped into 56 scenarios, reporting task goal completion (TGC), which we also call task success, and scenario goal completion (SGC), which requires every task of a scenario to succeed. SWE-bench Verified ( Jimenez et al., 2024 ) asks an agent to resolve a GitHub issue in a repository through shell commands, and we report the resolved rate over its 500 tasks. Our AppWorld harness follows the ReAct setup of the AppWorld release, with the one-shot demonstration from LOOP ( Chen et al., 2025 ) , and our SWE harness is adapted from mini-swe-agent ( Yang et al., 2024 ) . Every model, whether teacher, initial student or trained student, is evaluated in the same harness with the same prompts, budgets and grader, so that the models we compare differ only in how they were trained.
blocks.zh: 我们研究政策蒸馏 在两个长距离环境中。 AppWorld(Trivedi et al., 2024)要求代理商通过他们的API代表用户运行日常应用程序,我们使用它的测试-正常的168项任务分成56种情景,报告任务目标完成(TGC),我们也称任务成功(TGC),以及情景目标完成(SGC),这要求情景中的每一项任务都成功. SWE-bench Verife (Jimenez et al., 2024) 要求一名特工通过 shell 命令在一个寄存器中解决一个GitHub问题,我们报告解决率超过500项任务. 我们的AppWorld Up遵循AppWorld发行版的ReAct设定,LOOP(Chen等人,2025年)的一枪演示,而我们的SWE Up由迷你swe-agent(Yang等人,2024年)改编而来. 每个模型,无论是老师,初生还是受过训练的学生, 都用同样的提示, 预算和年级, 来评估,所以我们比较的模型 只在培训方式上有所不同.

blocks.en: The students are Qwen3-4B-Thinking-2507, referred to as Qwen3-4B, and Qwen3-32B ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , both post-trained reasoning models that reason in a think block by default. The open teacher is Qwen3.6-27B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) and the closed teacher is GPT-5.6 Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) , queried at reasoning effort xhigh through the Responses API with its encrypted reasoning items carried across turns.
blocks.zh: 学生分别是Qune3-4B-Thinking-2507,简称Qune3-4B,以及Qune3-32B. (Yang et al.,2025),两个经过训练后推理模型都默认在一个思维块中提出理由. 公开的老师是Quen3.6-27B(Quen Team,2026年),而封闭的老师是GPT-5.6 Luna(OpenAI,2026年),通过Answer API及其加密的推理项目在转弯时携带,询问推理努力x高.

blocks.en: Table 2: Task success of students distilled from the closed teacher, which has no full-CoT configuration as its reasoning is hidden. The CoT-proxy configuration uses the reasoning summaries returned by the API. The AppWorld recipe and evaluation are identical to Table 1 , and every AppWorld number is a three-seed mean, with its standard deviation for the scores. The SWE-bench students are trained on a larger set of teacher trajectories for five passes (Section 3 ) and are single runs, as is the teacher’s SWE-bench score. Turns is the mean number of model responses per task. In budget is the share of trajectories that end before exhausting the token budget of the accumulated context.
blocks.zh: 表2:从封闭的教师中蒸馏出来的学生的任务成功率,由于其推理被隐藏,因此没有全CoT配置. CoT代理配置使用API返回的推理摘要. AppWorld食谱与评价与表1相同,每个AppWorld的编号都是三种子平均值,其分数的标准差. SWE-bench的学生接受关于五门课(第3节)的更大一套教师轨迹的培训,也是单跑,教师的SWE-bench分数也是如此。 Turns是每个任务的模型响应的平均值. 在预算中,是指在耗尽累积情况象征性预算之前结束的轨迹份额。

blocks.en: Teacher data comes from rolling out each teacher on training tasks that are disjoint from the evaluation tasks. On AppWorld these are the 90 tasks of the official training split, and each teacher is run three times on each of them, which gives 270 trajectories per teacher, with 3,704 turns for the open teacher and 4,218 for the closed one. On SWE-bench we draw 250 training tasks from SWE-rebench ( Badertdinov et al., 2026 ) after removing the twelve repositories that SWE-bench is built from, so that no evaluation repository appears in training, and the open teacher is run once on each of them, which gives 250 trajectories with 8,993 turns. For the closed teacher on SWE-bench we collect more data. We draw 500 training tasks in the same way and run the teacher eight times on each, and we keep only the 2,970 of the 4,000 trajectories that resolve their task. Students are trained on this set for five passes with the recipe otherwise unchanged, and because of its cost we run this setting with a single seed. A teacher’s visible response usually contains more than the action, such as a sentence announcing the next step or explaining a result. This text is reasoning in another form, and keeping it would blur the comparison between training on actions alone and training on the CoT as well, so in every target we strip the visible response down to the parsed action, written as a single code block. Section 5 shows that keeping this text also lowers task success.
blocks.zh: 教师数据来自每个教师参加与评价任务脱节的培训任务。 在AppWorld上,这些是90项正式培训分拆的任务,每名教师在每名教师身上跑三次,每名教师有270个轨迹,公开教师有3 704个转弯,封闭教师有4 218个转弯。 在SWE-bench上,我们从SWE-rebench(Baderdinov等人,2026年)抽取了SWE-bench所建的十二个寄存器后,从中抽取250个训练任务,这样在训练中就不会出现评价寄存器,开放的教师在每一个寄存器上运行一次,使250个轨迹与8,993个转弯. 对于在SWE-bench上的封闭教师,我们收集更多的数据. 我们以同样的方式抽调500项训练任务,并逐个8次管理教师,我们只保留了4000个解决他们任务的轨迹中的2,970个. 学生们接受了关于这5个通行证的培训, 食谱没有改变, 由于其成本,我们用一个种子来管理这个环境。 老师的明显反应通常包含多于动作的内容,例如宣布下一步的句子或者解释一个结果. 这个文本是以另一种形式进行推理的,并且保留它会模糊关于行动的培训与关于CoT的培训之间的对比,因此在每一个目标中,我们都会将可见的反应剥离到解析的动作上,写成一个单一的代码块. 第5节表明,保留这一案文也会降低任务的成功率。

blocks.en: One recipe is used for every configuration, student, teacher and environment. Each environment is a separate experiment, in which the student is trained on that environment’s teacher data and evaluated on its test tasks. A training sample is an entire teacher trajectory rendered in the chosen target, with the loss covering the supervised tokens of every complete assistant turn in it, as laid out in Figure 1 . A trajectory longer than the training context is cut to the longest prefix of complete turns that fits for every target, so the three targets of a trajectory supervise the same turns. We fine-tune LoRA adapters ( Hu et al., 2022 ) for eight epochs over these trajectories, and each update mixes 17 of them with 3 replay samples, so replay accounts for 15% of an update. The replay pool contains 1,000 generations of the initial student on prompts from OpenR1-Math ( Hugging Face, 2025 ) and OpenAssistant ( Köpf et al., 2023 ) , covering mathematics, chat and instruction following, and a disjoint set of 100 generations is held out for measuring drift. The remaining hyperparameters are listed in Appendix B .
blocks.zh: 每种配置、学生、教师和环境都使用一种配方。 每个环境都是单独的实验,在实验中,学生接受有关该环境教师数据的培训,并对其测试任务进行评估。 如图1所示,培训样本是在选定的目标中完成的教师整个轨迹,损失包括每个完整的助理上交的受监督的标志。 轨迹比训练环境长的轨迹被切成每个目标最短的完整转弯前缀,因此轨迹的三个目标监督相同的转弯. 微调LORA适配器(Hu et al., 2022),为这些轨迹上的8个纪元,每一次更新会将其中17个与3个重播样本混合,因此重播占更新的15%. 重播池包含1000代来自OpenR1-Math(Hugging Face,2025年)和OpenApple(Köpf等人,2023年)的启蒙学生,涵盖数学,聊天和随后的教学,还有一组100代的脱节组合用于测量漂流. 其余的超参数列于附录B。

blocks.en: Every checkpoint is evaluated with thinking enabled, so that the student fills its think block before each action, under a budget of 50 interactions on AppWorld and 75 steps on SWE-bench, 8,192 output tokens per turn, and a context of 65,536 tokens (40,960 for Qwen3-32B). To check how much of the student’s original capability survives training, we evaluate the same checkpoints on three single-turn benchmarks and measure their drift from the initial model. The benchmarks are AIME 2025 ( AIME, 2025 ) , with four samples per problem for 120 answers in total, IFEval ( Zhou et al., 2023 ) , which scores whether a response follows verifiable instructions, and a stratified subset of 1,000 questions from MMLU-Pro ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Drift is measured as the KL divergence from the initial model to the student, in nats per token, on the 100 held-out continuations. We report the mean and standard deviation over three seeds. For a trained student, each seed is a separate training and evaluation run; for a baseline, it is a separate evaluation run.
blocks.zh: 每个检查点都通过思维能力来评估,这样学生在每次行动之前都会在AppWorld和SWE-bench的75个步骤的预算中填补思维障碍,每转弯8,192个输出令牌,上下文65,536个令牌(Qune3-32B为40,960个). 我们用三个单转基准来评估同样的检查站, 基准为AIME 2025(AIME,2025年),每题120个答案有4个样本,IFEval(周等人,2023年),评分一个答复是否遵循可核查的指令,以及MMLU-Pro(Wang等人,2024年)分级的1000个问题子集. 漂流被测量为从初始模型到学生的KL差异,以每令牌的nats表示,在被搁置的100个续作上. 我们报告三个种子的偏差和标准偏差。 对于受过训练的学生来说,每个种子都是单独的培训和评价运行;对于基线来说,是单独的评价运行.

blocks.en: Table 3: Replay fraction and capability retention for the Qwen3-4B student trained on AppWorld with open-teacher data. AIME25, IFEval and MMLU-Pro are the single-turn benchmarks with reported accuracy. KL is the held-out divergence from the initial model to the student in units of 10 − 3 10^{-3} nats per token, where lower is better. Every cell averages three training seeds, each evaluated once, and the better run of each pair is in bold.
blocks.zh: 表3:为在AppWorld接受开放教师数据培训的Quen3-4B学生重播分数和能力保留. AIME25、IFEval和MMLU-Pro是报告的准确性单回合基准。 KL 是从初始模式到学生的悬殊, 单位为 10 - 3 10 - 3 - 3 ) nats / a order, 其中较低。 每个细胞平均有3个训练种子,每个种子评估一次,每对种子的较好运行用粗体表示.

blocks.en: 4 Results
blocks.zh: 4 结果

blocks.en: Tables 1 and 2 contain the main results for the open and the closed teacher. In every table a number is the mean over three seeds, followed by its standard deviation. Appendix D.4 tests the differences between targets with paired statistics over tasks and seeds.
blocks.zh: 表1和表2列出了公开教师和封闭教师的主要成绩。 在每个表格中,一个数字是3个种子的平均值,其次是其标准偏差。 附录D.4对任务和种子的配对统计指标之间的差异进行了测试。

blocks.en: The action-only configuration in Table 1 shows that a policy can be learned from targets that contain no reasoning at all. On AppWorld, task success for Qwen3-4B increases from 7.3% to 17.9% and for Qwen3-32B from 11.5% to 25.4%. On SWE-bench it increases from 2.7% to 5.5% for Qwen3-4B and from 5.8% to 14.3% for Qwen3-32B. In every one of these evaluations the student fills its think block before it acts, so the learned policy is carried out by the student’s own reasoning.
blocks.zh: 表1中仅行动配置显示,政策可以从根本没有推理的目标中学习. 在AppWorld上,Qune3-4B的任务成功率从7.3%提高到17.9%,Qune3-32B的任务成功率从11.5%提高到25.4%。 在SWE-Bench中,Qune3-4B从2.7%增加到5.5%,Qune3-32B从5.8%增加到14.3%。 在每一次评估中,学生都会在行动前填补思想障碍,因此学习政策是由学生自己的推理执行的.

blocks.en: Full-CoT training, which keeps the teacher’s reasoning in the target, is ahead of action-only training in two of the four settings, by 11 points for the 4B student on AppWorld and by 7 points for the 32B student on SWE-bench. In the other two settings the two targets are within three points of each other. Dropping the teacher’s reasoning therefore costs task success in some settings but not in others, and the next paragraph shows that CoT-proxies recover this loss. The full-CoT student also takes the most turns per task of the trained students in every setting, yet it is the best in none of them, so the additional steps do not turn into success. On AppWorld it is also the student that most often exhausts its token budget, in 20% of the trajectories for Qwen3-4B and 35% for Qwen3-32B against at most 10% for the other trained students, which suggests that it struggles to bring its tasks to an end. Ending within the budget does not imply success, however: the initial models end within the budget in 80–99% of the trajectories and yet solve the fewest tasks.
blocks.zh: Full-CoT训练将老师的推理保留在目标中,在四个场合中的两个位置上领先只行动训练,AppWorld上的4B学生得11分,SWE-bench上的32B学生得7分. 在另外两种情况下,两个目标相互间在三个点之内。 因此,放弃老师的推理会在某些情况下但在其他情况下造成任务成功,下一段表明,CoT代理公司可以收回这一损失。 全科学生在每一个环境里都承担着训练有素的学生的每个任务最轮到的课,然而,这在其中任何一个环境里都是最好的课,所以附加的步骤不会变成成功的课. 在AppWorld上,学生也经常耗尽象征性预算,在Qune3-4B的20%和Qune3-32B的35%的轨迹中,其他受过训练的学生最多只能耗尽10%的轨迹,这表明他们正在努力结束任务。 然而,在预算范围内结束并不意味着成功:最初的模式在预算范围内以80-99%的轨迹结束,但却解决了最少的任务。

blocks.en: Adding a summary of the teacher’s reasoning after the empty think block raises Qwen3-4B from 17.9% to 34.5% on AppWorld and from 5.5% to 15.1% on SWE-bench. The CoT-proxy students have the highest mean in every column of Table 1 , although their lead over full-CoT training is statistically significant only for Qwen3-4B on SWE-bench. The signal costs no reasoning tokens, since the student still never trains on the teacher’s reasoning, and the summaries are far shorter than the reasoning they condense, on average 26 tokens against 124 on AppWorld and 20 against 81 on SWE-bench.
blocks.zh: 在空智块后添加教师推理摘要,将Qwen3-4B从AppWorld的17.9%提升到34.5%,将SWE-bench的5.5%提升到15.1%。 在表1的每栏中,CoT-代理学生的中位数最高,尽管他们在全CoT培训方面的领先地位在统计学上仅对SWE-bench上的Qune3-4B具有显著意义. 由于学生从未接受过老师的推理训练, 并且总结比他们所归纳的推理要短得多,

blocks.en: Table 2 repeats the AppWorld experiment with GPT-5.6 Luna as the teacher, a stronger model that solves 89.3% of the test tasks against 60.7% for the open teacher. Its reasoning is hidden, and its API returns a summary of that reasoning together with the visible response. The action-only target is therefore built from the visible responses alone, and the CoT-proxy target places the API summary between the empty think block and the action, in the same position as the summaries we generate for the open teacher. Action-only training again transfers the policy, raising task success from 7.3% to 35.1% for Qwen3-4B and from 11.5% to 44.4% for Qwen3-32B, and CoT-proxy training raises it further, to 48.2% and 59.1%, respectively. On SWE-bench, where the closed teacher resolves 88.2% of the tasks against 69.3% for the open one, we train on the larger set of closed-teacher trajectories. Action-only training raises Qwen3-4B from 2.7% to 18.0% and Qwen3-32B from 5.8% to 27.8%, and CoT-proxy training reaches 27.8% and 35.2%, in a single run each. The same recipe therefore distills a closed teacher in both environments even though its reasoning stays hidden.
blocks.zh: 表2重复了以GPT-5.6 Luna为老师的AppWorld实验,这个较强的模型解决了89.3%的测试任务,而开放教师的测试任务为60.7%. 它的推理被隐藏起来,它的API返回了该推理的总结和可见的反应. 因此,只行动目标仅从可见的响应中构建出来,CoT代理目标将API摘要置于空思考块与动作之间,与我们为开放老师生成的摘要处于相同位置. 只有行动培训再次转移了该政策,将Qune3-4B的任务成功率从7.3%提高到35.1%,将Qune3-32B的任务成功率从11.5%提高到44.4%,CoT-代用培训则进一步提高到48.2%和59.1%。 在SWE-bench上,关闭的老师解决88.2%的任务,而开放的老师则解决69.3%的任务,我们用更大的一套封闭的老师轨迹来训练. 只行动培训将Qune3-4B从2.7%提高到18.0%,Qune3-32B从5.8%提高到27.8%,CoT代用培训分别达到27.8%和35.2%。 因此,同样的食谱在两种环境中都提炼出一位封闭的教师,尽管其推理仍然不为人知。

blocks.en: 5 Ablations
blocks.zh: 5项

blocks.en: Beyond the targets themselves, the recipe rests on four choices: the replay regularization, the placement of the summary outside the think block, the source of the summary, and the removal of the teacher’s visible text. This section tests each of them with additional training runs of the 4B student on AppWorld, keeping everything else in the recipe fixed.
blocks.zh: 除了目标本身之外,配方还有四个选择:重播规范化,将摘要放在思想块之外,摘要的来源,以及删除老师的可见文本. 本节通过AppWorld上的4B学生的附加训练对每个学生进行测试,使食谱中的其他一切都固定下来.

blocks.en: Table 3 trains each target with and without replay regularization. Without replay, full-CoT training lowers AIME accuracy from 74.7% to 68.9% and raises the held-out KL divergence from the initial model from 0.003 to 0.042 nats per token. The action-only and CoT-proxy targets lose less on AIME without replay, while their divergence rises in the same way, and replay removes that rise as well. On IFEval and MMLU-Pro every configuration stays within about one point of the initial model, and the regularized run is ahead in each pair as well.
blocks.zh: 表3 列车对每个目标进行规范化和不进行规范化改造. 不重播,全CoT训练将AIME精度从74.7%降低到68.9%,并将被搁置的KL差异从初始型号从0.003升至0.042 nats每令牌. 仅行动和CoT-代用目标在AIME上失去较少而不重播,而它们的分歧以同样的方式上升,重播也消除了这种上升. 在 IFEval 和 MMLU-Pro 上,每个配置都停留在初始模型的大约1点以内,而正规化的运行也在每对中领先.

blocks.en: Replay also brings a small gain in task success. On AppWorld it rises from 28.2% to 29.2% for full-CoT, from 14.3% to 17.9% for action-only and from 29.4% to 34.5% for CoT-proxy. The regularized run is ahead in every pair, although the differences lie within the seed spread.
blocks.zh: 重播也为任务的成功带来了小收益. 在AppWorld上,纯CoT从28.2%上升至29.2%,仅行动就从14.3%上升至17.9%,CoT代理从29.4%上升至34.5%。 正规化的跑步在每对赛跑中都领先,虽然差异在于种子传播.

blocks.en: Table 4 replaces the out-of-domain replay pool with an in-domain one, built by running the initial student three times on each of the 90 AppWorld training tasks and sampling 1,000 of its responses, each kept with the context it was generated in. Task success drops for the three targets, and the action-only student ends at the 7.3% of the initial model. Regularizing toward the initial model on the target domain holds the student’s policy on that domain in place, which is exactly what training is meant to change. The replay data therefore has to come from outside the target environment.

The out-of-domain column repeats the runs of Table 1 ; the in-domain column replaces the replay pool by the initial student’s own AppWorld training trajectories.

blocks.en: Table 5 tests whether the CoT-proxy gain depends on where the summary is placed. For this we train a summary-as-CoT variant on the same teacher trajectories and summaries as the CoT-proxy target, but instead of placing each turn’s summary after an empty think block, we place it inside the think block, where the full-CoT target has the teacher’s reasoning. The student is then trained on these targets exactly as on full-CoT targets, with only the opening token prefilled and the summary, the closing token and the action supervised, so the summary serves as a short chain-of-thought. With the open teacher’s summaries this variant reaches 23.4% against 34.5% for CoT-proxies, and with the closed teacher’s summaries 33.9% against 48.2%. It also falls below full-CoT training, at 29.2% for the open teacher. A summary is therefore a poor substitute for the teacher’s reasoning inside the think block, but a useful signal outside it as a CoT-proxy.
blocks.zh: 表5测试CoT-代用增益是否取决于汇总位置. 为此,我们用和CoT的副目标一样的教师轨迹和摘要来训练一个“即时”变体,但是,我们不是将每个回合的总结放在一个空的思维块之后,而是放在思维块之内,即完全的CoT目标有教师的推理。 然后,学生接受与完全CoT目标完全一样的关于这些目标的培训,只有启蒙符号预先填充和摘要,关闭符号和动作监督,所以摘要充当了短的思考链. 根据公开教师摘要,这一变体占23.4%,CoT代理占34.5%,而封闭教师摘要占33.9%,占48.2%。 培训也低于全科培训,开放教师为29.2%。 因此,总结是教师在思维块内的推理的劣质替代,但作为CoT-代用词,它以外的一个有用的信号.

blocks.en: Table 5: AppWorld task success of Qwen3-4B with 15% replay when the same teacher summary is placed after the empty think block (CoT-proxy) or inside it (summary as CoT), three training seeds per cell. The summary-as-CoT variant keeps the same summary text and the same actions but places the summary inside the think block and supervises it as the full-CoT target supervises the teacher’s thought. The remaining entries repeat the runs of Tables 1 and 2 .
blocks.zh: 表5 AppWorld任务成功Qwen3-4B,在空智块(CoT-proxy)后或内部(摘要为CoT)放置同一老师摘要时,每细胞3个训练种子,重播15%. 摘要-as-CoT变体保留了相同的摘要文本和相同的动作,但将摘要放在思想块内,并监督它,因为完整的CoT目标监督老师的思想. 其余条目重复表1和表2的运行。

blocks.en: The summaries of the open teacher are written by the teacher model itself with thinking enabled, and almost all of the generation cost is the annotator’s own reasoning (Appendix A ). Table 6 replaces this annotator while keeping the trajectories, the actions and the recipe fixed. Summaries written from the same teacher reasoning by Qwen3-4B-Instruct, a model of the student’s size without a reasoning mode, are at least as useful as the default ones, at about 1% of the annotation cost. A much weaker annotator, Qwen3-1.7B, whose drafts are rejected more often and leave 12% of the turns without a summary, loses most of the gain over action-only training, so the annotator has to be capable enough but does not have to be large. The last variant gives the default annotator no access to the teacher’s reasoning and asks it to explain the action from the task, the last observation and the action itself. These post-hoc explanations recover about two thirds of the gain of CoT-proxies over action-only training, 29.0% against 34.5% and 17.9%. A summary of the actual reasoning is therefore the better signal, but an explanation written after the fact remains useful when neither the reasoning nor a summary of it is available.
blocks.zh: 开放教师的总结是由教师模型自己用允许的思维撰写的,几乎所有的生成成本都是注释员自己的推理(附录A. 表6取代了这个注释器,同时保持了轨迹,动作和食谱的固定. 由Qune3-4B-Instruct(一个没有推理模式的学生规模模型)撰写的同一教师推理摘要,至少与默认的一样有用,大约占注释成本的1%. 一个实力较弱的注释者Qwen3-1.7B,其草稿更经常被否决,并留下12%的转弯没有摘要,因此损失了大部分收益,因为只行动训练,所以注释者必须足够能力,但不必很大. 最后的变体让默认的注释者无法访问老师的推理,并要求它解释任务中的动作,最后的观察和动作本身. 这些事后解释收回了CoT代理公司对只行动培训的大约三分之二的收益,29.0%对34.5%和17.9%。 因此,对实际推理的总结是更好的信号,但是,在既无推理又无摘要的情况下,事后写出的解释仍然是有用的.

The first three rows summarize the teacher’s reasoning with different annotators; the post-hoc explanation is written by the default annotator from the task, the last observation and the action, without teacher’s reasoning. blocks.en: Every target strips the teacher’s visible response down to the parsed action (Section 3 ). Table 7 instead keeps the visible response as the teacher wrote it, including the text around the action. This lowers task success in every configuration. Full-CoT training changes little, from 29.2% to 28.2%, while CoT-proxy training loses 10 to 12 points for both teachers and action-only training falls to about 5%, below the 7.3% of the initial model. The teacher’s visible text is therefore not a substitute for a CoT-proxy, and the targets that leave the think block empty depend on its removal.
blocks.zh: 每个目标都会将老师的明显反应剥离到解析的动作(第3节). 相反,表7保留了教师所写的明显反应,包括围绕动作的文字。 这降低了每个配置中任务的成功率. 全COT培训变化不大,从29.2%到28.2%,而CoT代理培训在教师中均损失10至12分,而只行动培训则下降到5%左右,低于初始模式的7.3%。 因此,老师的可见文本不能替代CoT-proxy,使思维块空置的目标取决于其去除.

The first column repeats the runs of Tables 1 and 2 .

blocks.en: 6 Analysis
blocks.zh: 6 分析

blocks.en: This section inspects the responses of the Qwen3-4B students from Table 1 on AppWorld to see how training on targets without reasoning changes the student’s behavior at inference. We check whether the CoT-proxy student writes summaries at inference, and show how each training target affects the student’s reasoning pattern.
blocks.zh: 本节检查AppWorld上表1的Quen3-4B学生的反应,看看在没有推理的情况下训练目标如何改变学生在推论中的行为. 校对:Soup

blocks.en: The CoT-proxy target trains the student to write a summary between the empty think block and the action, so one would expect the student to write summaries at inference as well. It does not . Across all responses of the CoT-proxy student on AppWorld, the summary tags never appear, neither in the visible response nor inside the think block. Its gain over action-only training therefore comes from what the summaries teach about the policy and about the student’s own reasoning, not from a summary produced at test time. A plausible explanation is that the summary and its opening tag are always conditioned on an empty think block during training, a context that never occurs at inference. Once the student has filled the think block with its own reasoning, it proceeds to the action. Figure 3 in Appendix C shows a representative turn.
blocks.zh: CoT-代理目标训练学生在空智块和动作之间写一个摘要,所以人们会期望学生也能在推论中写一个摘要. 它没有。 在AppWorld上的CoT-proxy学生的所有响应中,摘要标记从未出现,无论是在可见的响应中还是在思维块内. 因此,它比只行动培训的好处来自总结对政策和学生自身推理的教导,而不是来自测试时制作的总结。 一个合理的解释是,摘要及其开口标记总是以训练期间的空洞思维块为条件,这种背景从来就没有推论. 学生一旦用自己的推理填满了思想块,便开始行动. 附录图3 C显示具有代表性的转弯。

blocks.en: Every student reasons in its think block at inference, but the training target changes what it writes there. Figure 2 shows the length of the closed think blocks of all responses of the three seeds, next to the teacher’s thoughts in the training data. The initial student reasons at length. Its median think block is 541 tokens over all turns and 4,739 tokens in the first turn of a task, whereas the teacher’s thoughts have a median of 66 tokens. Full-CoT training moves the student onto the teacher’s distribution, with a median of 70 tokens. CoT-proxy training shortens the median even further, to 49 tokens, while keeping a tail of long thoughts, and action-only training keeps most of the initial pattern, with a median of 219 tokens over all turns and 4,601 tokens in the first turn.
blocks.zh: 每一个学生在思考过程中 都会在推论中提出理由 但训练目标会改变它写的东西 图2显示三个种子所有反应的闭合思维块的长度,旁边是教师在培训数据中的想法。 初学因长. 它的中位思想块是541个符号,在任务的第一个回合是4,739个符号,而老师的思想中位数是66个符号。 Full-CoT训练将学生推向教师的分布,中间值为70令牌. CoT-代理训练将中位数缩短得更远,达到49个令牌,同时保持了长思的尾声,只行动训练保留了大部分初始模式,所有转弯的中位数为219个令牌,第一转弯为4,601个令牌.

blocks.en: Length is not the only difference – the wording of the think block separates full-CoT training from the other two targets as well. In the first two turns of every test task, the full-CoT student opens 85% of its think blocks the way the teacher does, with “The user wants”, and almost never uses the initial student’s “Wait”, which appears in 98% of the initial student’s think blocks. The action-only and CoT-proxy students keep the initial student’s wording and open with “Okay” in 100% and 86% of their think blocks (Table 8 ). All three targets shorten the student’s reasoning, action-only the least, but in our measurements only training on the teacher’s reasoning changes how the student phrases it; with actions or CoT-proxies as the target, the student keeps its own wording. Appendix C gives the per-seed statistics and think blocks of the four students on the same tasks.
blocks.zh: 长度并不是唯一的区别 — — 思维块的措辞将全CoT训练与其他两个目标也分开. 在每一次测试任务的头两个回合,全科T学生打开85%的思维屏蔽了老师的思维方式,用“用户想要的 ” , 几乎从不使用初学者的“等待 ” , 这出现在初学者的思维屏蔽的98%中。 仅行动学生和CoT代理学生保留最初学生的用词,并用100%和86%的思想块(表8)的“好”打开。 这三项目标都缩短了学生的推理,但至少是行动, 在我们的测量中,只有老师的推理训练才能改变学生的语句; 以行动或CoT代言为目标, 学生保留自己的语言。 附 录 C给出了四个学生的每个种子统计和思想块,任务相同.

blocks.en: 7 Related work
blocks.zh: 7 相关工作

blocks.en: Reinforcement learning is the main route to long-horizon agents. Kimi Team et al. (2026) combine a large-scale agentic data synthesis pipeline with a joint reinforcement learning stage, Cao et al. (2026) synthesize verifiable coding tasks with executable environments and learn from their feedback, Luo et al. (2025) train Qwen3-32B on software engineering tasks with reinforcement learning alone, and Chen et al. (2025) train an agent on AppWorld with a leave-one-out variant of PPO. When a stronger teacher exists, supervised fine-tuning on its trajectories is the cheaper alternative, and much of the work on open agents goes into collecting such trajectories at scale. Pan et al. (2025) sample them from strong models in SWE-Gym, Ludwig et al. (2026) fine-tune in two stages on trajectories of Qwen3-Coder-480B, and Pi et al. (2026) release most of their terminal trajectory corpus together with the models trained on it. We take the supervised route, fine-tuning a post-trained reasoning student to extend its capabilities to long-horizon tasks, but where this fine-tuning normally includes the teacher’s CoT, we show that the actions alone are enough to transfer the policy, which opens the same route to closed teachers.
blocks.zh: 强化学习是通向远视剂的主要途径. 纪美 Team et al. (2026)结合了大规模剂性数据合成管道和联合强化学习阶段,曹等人. (2026)结合可执行环境合成可核查的编码任务,并学习其反馈,Luo等人. (2025年) Qwen3-32B次列车执行软件工程任务,单独进行加固学习,Chen et al. (2025年) 在AppWorld上用PPO的留一变型进行代理培训. 当有更强大的教师时,对其轨迹进行有监督的微调是更便宜的选择,许多关于开放代理的工作都用于大规模收集这种轨迹。 Pan等人(2025年)从SWE-Gym,Ludwig等人(2026年)的强模型中对其进行取样,分两个阶段对Qune3-Coder-480B的轨迹进行微调,以及Pi等人. (2026年)他们大部分的末端轨迹体与所训练的模型一起发布. 我们走有监督的路线,微调一个受过后训练的推理学生,使其能力扩展到长视线任务,但如果这种微调通常包括老师的COT,我们就表明,单靠行动就足以将政策转移,这为封闭的教师打开了同样的路线.

blocks.en: For closed teachers, whose APIs return at most a summary of the reasoning and encrypt the rest to prevent distillation, Penaloza et al. (2026) conclude that hidden reasoning breaks standard distillation and propose two alternatives: training a teacher conditioned on privileged information jointly with an unconditioned student within the same model, and on-policy self-distillation, which trains the student with reinforcement learning and a reverse-KL penalty toward that teacher. We reach the same data condition with supervised fine-tuning alone, and show that the reasoning summaries an API returns suffice as an additional signal.
blocks.zh: 对于封闭的教师,他们的API最多返回一个推理摘要,并加密其余的防止蒸馏,Penoroza等人(2026年)的结论是,隐藏的推理打破了标准蒸馏,并提出两种替代办法:培训一名教师与同一模式内无条件的学生共同接受以特权信息为条件的训练;以及政策上的自我消化,通过强化学习和反向KL惩罚来培训学生。 我们仅通过有监督的微调就达到同样的数据条件,并表明推理摘要一个API返回就足以作为额外信号.

blocks.en: Cross-format transfer, where a reasoning model is trained with its CoT disabled and the effect of training persists at inference with the CoT enabled, has so far appeared as a safety result. Betley et al. (2025) find that fine-tuning a model only on writing insecure code makes it broadly misaligned, and Chua et al. (2025) show that the same happens when a reasoning model is fine-tuned on such narrow behavior with its CoT disabled and evaluated with the CoT re-enabled. We use this transfer deliberately, to teach a useful long-horizon policy, and measure where it lands and what it costs the student’s own reasoning.
blocks.zh: 跨格式的转移,即一个推理模型被训练为COT功能失效,而培训的效果则一直以COT功能推论为基础,到目前为止,这种转移已经成为一种安全结果。 Betley等人(2025年)发现,仅对写不安全代码的模型进行微调,使其大致错配,Chua等人(2025年)表明,如果推理模型在如此狭义的行为上被微调,其CoT被禁用并被CoT重新启用评价,也会发生同样的情况. 我们有意地使用这种转移,来教导一种有用的长视线政策,并衡量它在哪里着陆以及它花费学生自己的推理。

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en: We have shown that a teacher’s long-horizon policy can be distilled into a post-trained reasoning student without training on the teacher’s CoT. The student learns from targets whose reasoning block is empty, thinks at inference, and is held near its initial model by a KL penalty on a replay buffer of its own generations. CoT-proxies add a signal about the teacher’s reasoning that needs no reasoning tokens and improves on actions alone, and the same recipe distills closed teachers from their visible outputs and API summaries. We hope that learning the policy without imitating the teacher’s reasoning offers a practical route for adapting reasoning models to long-horizon tasks while retaining what they already know.
blocks.zh: 我们已表明,教师的长视野政策可以被提炼成一个经过后期培训的推理生,而无需经过教师的COT培训. 学生从那些推理障碍为空的目标学习,思考推论,被KL惩罚在自己世代的重玩缓冲器上紧贴其初始模型. CoT-代理增加了一个信号,说明教师的推理不需要推理符号,而且仅靠行动就能改进,同样的食谱也从显式产出和API摘要中提炼出封闭的教师. 我们希望,在不模仿教师推理的情况下学习政策,为调整推理模式以适应长期任务,同时保留他们已经知道的东西,提供了一个切实可行的途径。

blocks.en: Ethics statement
blocks.zh: 道德操守说明

blocks.en: Our closed-teacher experiments use only what the provider’s API returns to any user, the visible responses and the reasoning summaries, and make no attempt to recover the hidden reasoning. Terms of service of model providers may restrict the use of outputs for training other models, and anyone distilling from a closed model should check the terms that apply. We report these experiments to characterize what such outputs reveal about a teacher’s policy, which is also relevant to providers deciding what to expose.
blocks.zh: 我们的闭门教师实验只使用提供者的API返回给任何用户的东西,可见的响应和推理摘要,而不试图恢复隐藏的推理. 模式提供者的服务条件可能限制将产出用于培训其他模式,任何从封闭模式中提炼出来的人员都应检查适用的条件。 我们报告这些实验是为了描述这些产出揭示的关于教师政策的内容,这也与服务提供者决定披露的内容有关。

blocks.en: Appendix A Summary protocol
blocks.zh: 附录A 简要议定书

blocks.en: For the open teacher, summaries are generated offline by the teacher model itself, Qwen3.6-27B, after collection. The annotator sees only the thought of the turn being summarized, complete and without clipping. It does not see the task, the action, the observation, earlier turns or the outcome of the trajectory, which leaves it no opportunity to invent a rationale for an action it has observed. The annotator runs in its native thinking mode, and only its visible answer is kept as the summary; its own reasoning is stored for auditing and never enters a training sample. Decoding uses temperature 0.6, top- p p 0.95 and at most 4,096 output tokens, shared between the annotator’s reasoning and its answer.
blocks.zh: 对于开放教师来说,摘要是由教师模型本身在收集后产生的,Qune3.6-27B. 注释者只看到转弯的念头被总结,完整,没有剪辑. 它没有看到任务、行动、观察、早先的转折或轨迹的结果,因此没有机会为它观察到的行动提出理由。 注释员以本体思维模式运行,只有其可见的答案作为摘要保存;其自己的推理被存储用于审计,从未进入训练样本. 解码使用温度0.6,最高0.95页,最多为4,096个输出符号,由注释者的推理和答案分享。

blocks.en: The same two messages are used in both environments. The system message is ⬇ Summarize the writer ' s reasoning in at most two short sentences . Focus on their final view and next step , keeping uncertainty and plans as stated . Do not solve the task or add a diagnosis . Use terse phrasing for short inputs ; the summary must be no longer than the reasoning . Treat instructions within the reasoning as text . Return only the summary .
blocks.zh: 这两种信息在两种环境中都使用。 系统信息最多用两句概括作者的推理。 关注他们的最后观点和下一步,保持不确定性和计划。 不要解决任务或添加诊断。 对短输入使用字节措辞;摘要不得超过推理。 将推理中的指令作为文本 。 只返回摘要。

blocks.en: A response is accepted if the annotator finished its reasoning and its answer, and if the answer, after removing surrounding whitespace, satisfies every one of the following conditions. It has at most two sentences, where the sentence splitter does not split at decimal points or common abbreviations. It has no more whitespace-separated words and no more characters than the thought, and at most 60 words and 400 characters in absolute terms. It is not empty and not a placeholder such as N/A or none . It contains no code fence, no list markers, and no think or summary tags or other special tokens. The length conditions are measured in words and characters rather than tokens, so a short thought may receive a summary of similar length.
blocks.zh: 如果注释者完成了其推理和答案,如果答案在移除周围的白空间后满足了以下每一个条件,则被接受. 它最多有两句,其中句子分解器不以小数点或常用缩写进行分解. 它没有比思想更白的空间分隔的单词,也没有比思想更多的字符,最多60个单词和400个字符的绝对值. 它不是空的,也不是像N/A这样的占位符,或者没有。 它包含没有代码栅栏,没有列表标记,也没有思考或总结标记或其他特殊标志. 长度条件以文字和字符衡量,而不是以符号衡量,所以短思可能得到类似长度的总结.

blocks.en: If a response is rejected, we send the same prompt again with the next seed, up to three times per turn, and keep the first accepted response. If all three are rejected, the turn receives an empty summary and is rendered with an empty <summary></summary> block.
blocks.zh: 如果拒绝答复,我们将再次以下一个种子发出同样的提示,每个转弯最多3次,并保持第一个接受的答复. 如果所有三个都被拒绝,则转弯会收到一个空摘要,并用一个空的<摘要>/摘要>块提供。

blocks.en: For GPT-5.6 Luna we generate no summaries ourselves. The teacher is queried through the Responses API at reasoning effort xhigh with the reasoning summary parameter set to detailed , without storing responses on the provider side ( store=false ), and with the encrypted reasoning items of all earlier turns passed back in each request. Each response can contain several reasoning items, each with several summary chunks. We keep every chunk in the order returned, join the chunks of one response with newlines, and treat a response whose joined summary is empty or only whitespace as having no summary. The summaries are not shortened, filtered or regenerated, and they keep the formatting in which they are returned.

blocks.en: D.1 Thinking enabled versus disabled
blocks.zh: D.1 联合国 思维启用与禁用

blocks.en: Qwen3-32B is a hybrid model that supports inference with and without thinking ( Yang et al., 2025 ) , which lets us ask how much of a trained student’s performance depends on reasoning at inference. We evaluate the initial model and the CoT-proxy student trained on the open teacher’s SWE-bench trajectories a second time with thinking disabled, by prefilling an empty think block, with everything else unchanged. Table 13 gives the results. The initial model loses little without thinking, whereas the CoT-proxy student drops from 21.7% to 5.1%, so its gain rests on reasoning at inference. Without thinking, both also take more turns per task.
blocks.zh: Qune3-32B是一个支持推论和不思考的混合模型(Yang等人,2025年),让我们问一个受过训练的学生的成绩有多少取决于推论的推理. 我们通过预先填充一个空洞的思维屏障,对初代模型和CoT-proxy学生进行第二次关于开放老师的SWE-bench轨迹的培训, 表13列出了结果。 最初的模型没有思考就几乎没有损失,而CoT-代理学生从21.7%下降到5.1%,因此其收益取决于推论推理. 没有思考,两者也都会在每次任务中轮到更多的时间.

Every number is the mean over three seeds, with the standard deviation for the scores.

blocks.en: D.2 Content of the summary
blocks.zh: D.2 摘要的内容

blocks.en: To test whether CoT-proxy students use what the summaries say, we train further Qwen3-4B students on the open teacher’s AppWorld and SWE-bench trajectories with the CoT-proxy recipe, with the summaries randomly permuted across all turns of all training trajectories, so that each turn carries a well-formed summary written for another step. All other training text, the retained turns and the loss masks are identical to CoT-proxy. Table 14 shows that the shuffled-summary students do not come close to CoT-proxy: they are 5 points above action-only on AppWorld and below it on SWE-bench. The gain of CoT-proxy therefore comes from the content of the summaries rather than from the presence of a summary block.
blocks.zh: 为了测试CoT-代课生是否使用摘要中所说的内容,我们用公开的教师AppWorld和SWE-bench的配方来进一步训练Quen3-4B学生,这些摘要随机地贯穿于所有训练轨迹的所有转折,这样,每个转折都带有一个精致的总结,写成另一个步骤. 所有其他训练文本,保留的转弯和损失口罩与CoT-代用相同. 表14显示,被洗牌的总结学生并不接近CoT-代理:他们在AppWorld和SWE-bench上都比动作高5分。 因此,CoT-prooxy的收益来自于摘要的内容,而不是来自摘要块的存在.

blocks.en: D.4 Paired statistical comparisons
blocks.zh: D.4 经济统计比较

blocks.en: Every training target is evaluated on the same tasks with matched seeds, so we compare targets task by task. For each pair of targets we report the difference in task success averaged over the three seeds, a 95% confidence interval from a paired bootstrap over tasks (resampling whole scenarios on AppWorld; 10,000 resamples), and a p-value from a paired permutation test that swaps the outcomes of the two targets within each task or scenario, Holm-corrected within each table. Table 16 shows that action-only and CoT-proxy training improve on the initial model in every setting and that CoT-proxy improves on action-only in every setting except Qwen3-32B on AppWorld, where no difference between trained targets is significant. CoT-proxy and full-CoT differ significantly only for Qwen3-4B on SWE-bench.
blocks.zh: 每个培训目标都用匹配的种子评价相同的任务,因此我们按任务比较目标任务. 对于每对目标,我们报告三个种子平均任务成功率的差异,95%的置信间隔从一个对齐的靴子带到任务(在AppWorld上对整体情景进行抽样;10,000个复标),以及一个对齐的演化测试的p值,在每一个任务或情景中交换两个目标的结果,Holm在每一个表格中修正。 表16显示,每个设置中只有动作和CoT代用训练改进了初始模型,除了AppWorld上的Qwen3-32B之外,每个设置中只有动作和CoT代用训练改进了初始模型,AppWorld上受过训练的目标之间没有显著区别. 仅SWE-bench上的Quen3-4B的CoT-代用和全CoT差异很大.

blocks.en: Table 16: Paired differences in task success between training targets (percentage points; AppWorld TGC and SWE-bench Verified), averaged over three seed-matched runs. Confidence intervals are from a paired bootstrap over tasks (scenarios on AppWorld); p-values are from a paired permutation test, Holm-corrected within the open-teacher and the closed-teacher comparisons. Bold marks p < 0.05 p<0.05 .
blocks.zh: 表16:培训目标之间任务成功率的差异(百分点;AppWorld TGC和SWE-bench验证),平均在三个种子匹配的运行中。 置信间隔来自双靴子对任务(AppWorld上的假象);p值来自双胞胎演化测试,Holm在开放教师内部修正,封闭教师比较. 粗体标记p < 0.05p < 0.05。
